material.acceptance_criteria: A CI check where a mod orders the unit it spawned moves that unit in the served room, and an order to an unmapped id is refused and logged.
material.description: room.rs apply_mod_commands indexes the room by the mod's unit ids (room.rs ~250-260), so mod orders, damage and buffs can hit a different room unit once the worlds diverge. Map ids through a spawn-time table or key commands by a stable unit handle.
material.resolution: Mod spawns produce a handle; the room maps handle to the unit it created; orders, damage and buffs resolve through the map; unmapped handles are refused and logged. Moved proof is the served x,y change (43ced5ea).
material.subject: Map mod unit ids to room unit ids for order, damage and buff
